I can't make a strong case for buying this one. The brief shows the coin is down 42.8% over the last 15 minutes and 52.9% off its 30-minute high, with sellers (1,245) nearly matching buyers (1,324) and net flow negative at -21 SOL. The sell-to-buy ratio of 0.985 in the first two minutes after graduation means early demand was already being sold into almost immediately. The 30-minute return of +21.7% is real, but it's the tail of a move that has since reversed sharply.

The positives are limited. The curve looks organic: bundle share is low (8.4%), top-3 holders are small (7.7%), no airdrop dump was seen, and buyer count is high. Those features argue against a factory or insider-dump coin. But organic distribution doesn't establish that demand will persist. A large number of buyers who are now net sellers signals that the people who came in are leaving, not that new demand is arriving.

Against a round-trip cost of 1.4–5.1%, and a base rate of roughly -20% for random buys in this age window, the setup needs a clear reason for a rebound, and the brief doesn't supply one. The desk should skip this coin.
